title: Microsoft Teams: raise hand and speak on mic and camera in events with up to 100,000 attendees
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing and control routes are supported, but its claim that use rests with organisers rather than admin policy is too broad: it also documents a policy that prevents those organisers from running large events. Remove that claim of exclusive organiser control; the narrower absence of a feature-specific switch is supported.
